notes.title: Update on the progress
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
I know it's been a while since my last update, and I really appreciate your patience. I’ve been fully immersed in development beside my full time job, focusing on adding new features to the game. One of the biggest I’ve been tackling is the mission system, which turned out to be much more complex and time-consuming than I originally expected. But is shaping up to be a dynamic and engaging part of the experience. 
Beyond that, I've also been refining core gameplay mechanics to make the game smoother and more fun.

Thank you for sticking with me and being part of this journey. I can't wait to show you everything I've been working on soon. Stay tuned for more updates!

Have a good one!

Marko
